note: 0.3.1 gear market balance (smith AI + surplus sink). production: smiths/prospectors scale crafting of a wearable (head/body/legs/shield/weapon) by own unsold stock (stash + own open asks), the town's Exchange listing depth and the price vs base: factor = 1/(1+max(0,own-own_free)/own_span) x 1/(1+max(0,depth-depth_free)/depth_span) x clamp((price/base - price_stop)/(price_full - price_stop), 0, 1). commission_from_stock: a smith fills a commission from finished stock before forging. scrap: the town armourer buys surplus wearables for scrap at price_share x base (below any healthy Exchange price) from a separate daily purse per town (a bounded coin faucet; the goods leave the game). An agent scraps a piece when its local price is under scrap_below_price x base or the town's listing depth is over depth_free; producers keep keep_producer of each. Adventurers' outgrown gear and the unsold rest of estate sales go the same way. stock_aware: crafts of these items also back off with own stock and town depth; price_band {item: [stop, full]} adds a local price term (0.3.1: planks in a glutted town).
